callouts.body: Celadon needs iron in the glaze, not in the clay. Porcelain keeps the colour clean.
The new shelves held at cone 6 for three firings without warping.
The vent fan runs off the kiln room's own breaker. Switch it on before you start a firing.
Never open the kiln above 200 °C. Thermal shock cracks the shelves and the pots.
Two answers before the next firing:
list: Do the test tiles go on the top shelf?
